D.t: Colin Allred leads by 56.6 in the forecast and wins 100% of simulations. The cushion is about 138,590 votes; a one point swing is about 1,225 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +50.0 and D +62.2. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
Air cover: Outside groups spent $0 helping Patrick Gillespie and $50K helping Colin Allred.

R.t: Patrick Gillespie trails by 56.6 and wins 0% of simulations. Closing it takes about 69,295 voters switching sides, or 138,590 more net votes from new turnout.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between D +62.2 and D +50.0. Only an unusual polling error changes the winner.
